name: November
summary: The post-Halloween exhale: haunts close, holiday programming begins at some parks, and the weeks around Thanksgiving carry the month's two very different crowd realities.

verdict.short: November at these parks: a good window with known trade-offs. The post-Halloween exhale: haunts close, holiday programming begins at some parks, and the weeks around Thanksgiving carry the month's two very different crowd realities..

crowds.shape: The post-Halloween exhale: haunts close, holiday programming begins at some parks, and the weeks around Thanksgiving carry the month's two very different crowd realities.

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The early-November window is a genuine shoulder season at the warm-climate parks — the year's quietest full-operation days outside September.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: Holiday events open across the month at several parks and the Thanksgiving-to-December bridge crowds build steadily toward the holiday peak.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
